company.name: Edviro
company.shortDescription: Edviro develops artificial intelligence software for building operations and energy management.
company.description: Edviro develops artificial intelligence software for building operations and energy management. Its platform connects utility bills, meters, building management systems, and work order data to detect energy waste, automate operational tasks, verify energy savings, and support maintenance workflows. The company also provides digital twin capabilities for capital planning, project evaluation, and measurement and verification reporting.
